scene_sentence_zh: 潮濕的石砌地牢裡，燭火在牆上投下搖曳的影子，隱約傳來的聲響令人不安。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a damp stone dungeon passage deep underground, rough mortared walls beaded with moisture and moss, a row of barred iron cell doors receding down a dark corridor, burning wall torches casting flickering orange light and long shadows, scattered straw and rusted chains on the flagstones, a low vaulted stone ceiling, an unobstructed open stone floor across the lower foreground

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: a painterly JRPG dungeon interior — a vaulted damp stone passage with barred iron cell doors, rusted chains, scattered straw, mossy joints and burning wall torches casting long orange shadows over a wet flagstone floor — with an unobstructed open foreground for stage figures, no interface, watermark or readable lettering, and no town/forest reuse.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop (browser method web.tests.browser.test_browser_bundled_scene_assets.BundledSceneAssetsBrowserTest.test_interior_pack_static_decode): the full-bleed composition holds and the illustration stays distinguishable from its siblings at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed as a three-up contact sheet beside tavern_interior and ruin_interior: scene identity, palette and composition are distinct for every sibling.
